bridge_result.note: Marginals are built from DIFFERENT unit definitions (R2-05: single-expert request unit; R2-06: transition-derived, pairwise-expanded target unit) and are not expected to match exactly; only a GROSS divergence (> gross_divergence_threshold for some expert) is flagged.

global_summary.structure_axis: normalized_mutual_information (higher = more same-layer transition structure beyond marginal frequency)
global_summary.support_threshold_rationale: Predeclared before any real R2-06 execution, based on sample-count, not observed-result, considerations: MIN_SOURCE_SUPPORT=30 (a source expert's outgoing row must have at least this many total transition observations to be included in headline/strong-transition summaries), MIN_PAIR_SUPPORT=10 (an individual (source, target) cell must have at least this many observations to be reported as a 'strong transition'). Both are conservative, widely-documented minimum-sample-size conventions, not tuned to any R2-06 result -- no real R2-06 canonical run has occurred at the time these constants were fixed. Raw per-cell data is never filtered by this rule; only headline/strong-transition SUMMARIES are.
